decision_lens: Permanent failure modes (false success declaration, premature give-up) rank P0. Unnecessary retry cycles rank P1.
focus: How Skaffen runs tests after a patch, interprets failures, decides to retry or give up, and avoids local minima
name: fd-test-validation-loop
persona: A reliability engineer who studies how agents get stuck in patch-retry loops. Evaluates the Reflect phase as the primary failure site.
review_areas: Evaluate whether Reflect distinguishes environment failure vs test runner failure vs logic failure vs pass
Assess mechanism for comparing pre-patch and post-patch test output to isolate changed tests
Check for per-hypothesis retry limit to prevent dead-end patch variations
Evaluate git snapshot/revert integration in Reflect phase
Assess whether system prompt teaches 'incomplete patch' vs 'wrong call site' distinction
Check structured detection and recovery from environment bootstrap failures
success_hints: Agent correctly classifies test output type for 95%+ of cases
Agent detects regressions within one Reflect turn and reverts
task_context: Skaffen Go agent with OODARC phases in headless print mode for SWE-bench Lite. Goal: #1 (~60% baseline) through genuine improvements.
